MDG.note: Only a proposed Digital Investigation Unit in a bill; no strategy, body, incident or figures stated.

facts.fact: Eu SEE (Hivos) reports the National Assembly postponed the plenary vote on the cybercrime bill PL-042/2026, tabled 28 August 2026, with adoption of its 96 articles shelved indefinitely.
Eu SEE (Hivos) says draft Bill 40 (PL-040/2026) defines digital sovereignty as state surveillance and control of critical data and infrastructure; the vote was postponed.

MDG.note: Criticism is unattributed and no cut or punishment is stated; suspension power is only in a draft bill.
